purpose: Required and recommended Codex capabilities for the source_of_truth operating system.

tiers.required: Needed for full source_of_truth onboarding and normal project operating flow.
tiers.recommended: Strong default. Missing capability should be reported, but does not block unrelated work.
tiers.task_required: Required only when the active task matches this capability's domain.

policies.skill_catalog_policy: Do not paste full installed skill maps into global AGENTS files. Use live registry plus this compact capability registry.
policies.missing_required_behavior: Report BLOCKED or DEGRADED mode and do not pretend the capability is available.

capabilities.label: Source-of-Truth Onboarding
capabilities.reason: Builds or repairs the full project operating layer before implementation.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Manual onboarding falls back to playbooks/templates if the repo skill source is missing.

capabilities.label: Source-of-Truth Onboarding Installed Copy
capabilities.reason: Global Codex install lets the onboarding skill trigger outside this repo, but real global writes require explicit approval.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Use the repo-local skill source and scripts directly until global install is approved.

capabilities.label: Superpowers Workflow Pack
capabilities.reason: Provides mature brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, verification and review workflows.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Design and plan gates must fall back to local source_of_truth playbooks.

capabilities.label: Lazyweb Product UI Evidence
capabilities.reason: Product UI work must use real UI examples and Lazyweb evidence before design changes.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Product UI recommendations are blocked or marked degraded until Lazyweb is fixed.

capabilities.label: Context7 Current Docs
capabilities.reason: Current library, framework, SDK, API and cloud documentation must come from live docs.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Version-sensitive technical guidance is blocked until official docs are checked another way.

capabilities.label: Browser Verification Stack
capabilities.reason: Visible UI behavior must be verified in a real browser when a runnable UI exists.
capabilities.degraded_mode: UI claims require explicit degraded evidence and cannot rely on source reading alone.

capabilities.label: Codex System Skills
capabilities.reason: Core installation, creation, OpenAI docs and image generation workflows.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Skill install/create and OpenAI-specific workflows require manual fallback.

capabilities.label: Personal Style And Rules Helpers
capabilities.reason: Preserves the user's terse style, rules loading flow, skill discovery and context packaging.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Work continues, but style/rules sync/context packaging must be done manually.

capabilities.label: Security Baseline
capabilities.reason: Auth, payments, permissions, secrets and provider integrations need explicit security review paths.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Security-heavy work must be marked degraded or use manual review.

capabilities.label: Project Spec Documentation
capabilities.reason: Useful for lightweight PRD/spec artifacts, but source_of_truth will own the development-grade PRD flow.

capabilities.label: Documents And PDFs
capabilities.reason: Required only for Word, spreadsheet, presentation or PDF work.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Document conversion/editing tasks need manual tooling or must stop.

capabilities.label: Creative Artifact Skills
capabilities.reason: Required only when the user asks for decks, posters, dashboards, landing pages, video, audio or prototypes.
capabilities.degraded_mode: Use general implementation only after confirming artifact-specific skill is not needed.
